archetypes.name: dyn-tier-resume
archetypes.rationale: Audit and escalation state must stay stable across resumed review loops.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed difficulty resolution and resume paths for state drift. Focus on whether audit rolls happen exactly once, operator overrides remain logged, and escalated_round applies only to the target round. Check both implement Step 5 and design plan review callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
